items.text: When  a  decision  is  taken  unanimously  by  a  team,  jury  or  a committee,  a  singular  verb  is  used.  Similarly,  in  the  given sentence, the committee has given a single decision. Therefore, 'have' must be replaced with the singular verb 'has'. Hence, 'has given' is the most appropriate answer.
